channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cason Wallace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cason Wallace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sam Presti on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Presti on Cason Wallace extension convos:

“I think the greatest sign of respect we could’ve shown Cason is moving Lu in that trade… It’s a bit of a gesture to him to say we think you can have a great role on this team, we believe in you as a player, & we hope it can work out.”

Sam Presti on Cason Wallace, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Isaiah Hartenstein on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Isaiah Hartenstein:

“I think Cason Wallace has taken a huge step forward. Every night he guards one of the best players and he's doing an amazing job.. Ajay has gotten a lot better on defense. In general, we don't have a weak link on defense.”

Isaiah Hartenstein on Cason Wallace, Nov 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Jalen Williams on hyping Cason Wallace:

“Young player.. I say that like I’m old.. expected to do a lot on a good team his first two years.. I’m excited that he’s doing that on a big stage.. It’s hard not to be excited when your teammate does well.”

Jalen Williams on Cason Wallace, Apr 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Sam Presti on Cason Wallace:

“Cason's a no agenda player. He's making the play that's in front of him. He's making the right decision with how the game is unfolding.. He's serving the game. The thing I liked about him that really stuck out - all the hard things about basketball - he did those with his eyes wide open.”

Sam Presti on Cason Wallace, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace:

“Just how easy he is to trust as a 20-year-old... He's doing exactly what we're trying to accomplish in the game plan and system.”

Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace’s defense on the last play:

“He was awesome. 2 point game, we didn’t want to double.. He almost got the ball.”

Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on if he’s surprised at how quickly Cason Wallace has made an impact:

“Not really… Based on the evaluation we had on him in the draft. We kinda expected him to be able to come in and hang.”

Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace, Dec 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Stephen Curry, Cason Wallace
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace getting defensive reps on Steph Curry:

“It’s important for his development but he’s also earned it. We weren’t doing it solely for his development. We were doing it because he’s shown he can help us in those situations.”

Mark Daigneault on Stephen Curry, Cason Wallace, Nov 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Kenrich Williams on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Kenrich Williams on Cason Wallace:

“He’s been great, man for us. You would think he’s a 10-year vet with the way he plays the game…I told you guys man — buy your stock.”

Kenrich Williams on Cason Wallace, Nov 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace
item.description:
Stephen Jackson asked Chet Holmgren,

“[Shai Gilgeous-Alexander], Cason Wallace, Lu Dort, [Josh] Giddey, Jalen Williams, how do you feel about next year?”

Stephen Jackson on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace, Aug 2, 2023. Source: Thunderous Intentions.

item.title: Sam Presti on Cason Wallace
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Sam Presti on the Cason Wallace trade:

“This was an opportunity for us that made sense for both teams.”

Sam Presti on Cason Wallace, Jun 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.
